questions.question: Describe the architecture of the Intellectual Property Management System you developed using J2EE and SQL Server. What were the major components, data flows, and design decisions?

You have experience with T-SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, functions, views, and triggers. How would you diagnose and improve a slow-running query or database process in a finance or billing application?
This role supports scalable and reliable software solutions. Can you describe a production issue you helped troubleshoot, including how you identified the root cause and verified the fix?

Your background is primarily Java/J2EE, while this role uses .NET and C#. How would you apply your object-oriented design, web-service, and enterprise-application experience when working in a C#/.NET codebase?
Describe your experience designing data models and ER diagrams. How did you translate application requirements into tables, relationships, constraints, and database objects?
In your TSMC Online work, you developed e-commerce-related systems using Java, Struts, WebLogic, and Oracle. What considerations did you make for security, reliability, and transactional correctness?
Tell us about a technical design document you wrote, such as a URD, high-level design, detailed design, or UML diagram. Who used it, and how did it influence implementation and testing?
What was your approach to building, deploying, and supporting applications across development, test, and production environments? How did you manage deployment risk?
Describe a time you provided code reviews, technical guidance, or training to junior developers. What standards or practices did you emphasize?
For a billing or payment-related integration that calls an external service, how would you design the service to handle timeouts, transient failures, duplicate requests, and operational monitoring?
